prompt:
A sprite sheet of 12 separate props for a top-down pixel-art JRPG, drawn from the classic 3/4 top-down RPG angle (you see the top surface and the front face; objects stand upright, feet/base at the bottom). Arrange them in a 3 x 4 grid in reading order (left to right, top to bottom), with wide empty space between them; every prop is fully separate, none touching or overlapping, nothing cut off by the image edge. The props, in order: 1) single bed with a patchwork quilt and white pillow, head end at the top (seen from above at a steep angle); 2) tall wooden bookshelf full of colourful books; 3) long wooden shop counter with a ledger, scales and a small bell; 4) stone kitchen hearth / cooking stove with an iron pot (fire not lit, cold ashes); 5) tall wooden cupboard with two doors; 6) low dresser with drawers and a small mirror; 7) wooden stool; 8) clay pot with a leafy house plant; 9) wooden shelf rack with jars and bottles; 10) wooden wash tub; 11) rolled up rug; 12) wooden weapon rack holding two swords and a spear.
Scale: the bed is about 34 art pixels tall, the bookshelf about 40, the stool about 16; each art pixel is about 6x6 image pixels.
Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art ("HD pixel art" JRPG look), hand-placed pixels. Every art pixel is a crisp square of the same size across the whole image (about 8x8 image pixels per art pixel). No anti-aliasing, no blur, no soft brushes, no photographic texture, no noise, no dithering checkerboards. Clusters of 3-10 pixels with clear shapes. Hue-shifted colour ramps: shadows lean toward purple/red and are more saturated, highlights lean toward warm yellow. 4-6 shades per material, rich but earthy, worn and lived-in.
Lighting: neutral, soft, even light from the upper left, like a calm overcast evening; NO cast shadows, NO night darkness, NO light sources, NO glow, NO lamp light pools, NO vignette. (The game engine adds the night lighting on top later, so this must be the clean base colours.)
Interior furniture of a cosy old inn and shops.
Background: fully transparent. No ground under the props, no drop shadows, no text, no labels, no numbers.
revised_prompt: Create ONE transparent-background sprite sheet of 12 individual interior props for a cozy old inn and shops, premium modern high-bit 2D pixel art JRPG assets. STRICT LAYOUT: 3 COLUMNS x 4 ROWS, reading order left to right then top to bottom. Row 1: (1) a single wooden bed with a colorful patchwork quilt and white pillow, head end at the TOP, visible mattress top receding steeply upward in a classic 3/4 top-down RPG angle; (2) a tall wooden bookshelf packed with colorful books; (3) a LONG wooden shop counter, with ledger, weighing scales, and small bell on its top. Row 2: (4) stone kitchen hearth/cooking stove with an iron pot, UNLIT firebox containing only cold ashes; (5) tall wooden two-door cupboard; (6) low wooden dresser with drawers and a small upright mirror. Row 3: (7) small wooden stool; (8) clay flowerpot containing leafy green houseplant; (9) wooden shelf rack with assorted jars and bottles. Row 4: (10) wooden wash tub; (11) tightly rolled-up rug; (12) wooden weapon rack holding EXACTLY two swords and one spear. Each prop visibly separated from all other props by WIDE transparent blank space, nothing touching, none cropped. All objects in consistent classic 3/4 top-down RPG projection: top surface and front faces visible, standing upright with base/feet toward bottom. Bed about 34 art-pixels tall, bookshelf 40 art-pixels tall, stool 16 art-pixels tall, faithfully proportional scale; one art pixel uniformly around 8x8 physical image pixels across the entire sheet. Crisp hard-edged aligned square pixel blocks, hand-placed coherent 3-10 art-pixel color clusters, zero smoothing or antialiasing; 4-6 hues per material, warm yellow-tinted highlights and saturated purplish-red shadows, rich but earthy worn wood and stone. Soft EVEN neutral upper-left ambient illumination; clean base colors ready to be lit by a game engine, no cast shadows whatsoever. Fully transparent alpha background, NO floor or ground, NO drop shadows, NO gridlines or panel outlines, NO text, NO labels, NO numbers, NO visible lights or glow or flame, NO blur, NO texture noise, NO dithering.
